description: This PHP source file generates a web page for managing QoS settings. It includes dynamic JavaScript that initializes form controls based on device configuration, and handles saving settings via AJAX. The code interacts with device-specific functions and includes HTML structure for user interaction.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the web page form controls based on current configuration values for WMM and MoCA, setting the radio buttons accordingly.

methods.name: saveQoS
methods.description: Sends the updated QoS settings to the server via an AJAX POST request.
